rationale: The component-scope rule `.btn { color: red }` applies to the component's `<button class="btn">` (§9.1: `#{}` in a component compiles to its `@scope` block). §65.3.4: the built-in reset ships default-on — `margin` zeroed on `body`, `box-sizing: border-box` on every element. Form controls inherit `font` (the body's 16px).
